name: saasframe
description: Design from real SaaS references: search 2,000+ real pages, product screens and user flows, with the styles measured on each page.

interface.longDescription:
SaaSFrame is a curated library of real SaaS interfaces: website pages, product screens, user flows and isolated sections such as heroes and pricing tables. Connect it and your AI looks at how real products solved a screen before it designs yours.

Ask for a pricing page, an onboarding flow or a settings screen. SaaSFrame returns matching references with their screenshot, a description of the design, and the fonts, sizes, colors and radii measured on the live page. A design guide gives the method for each screen type, with benchmarks computed from real pages.

You can also read any public website section by section, export a section as code, Figma layers, a Framer component or a Webflow paste, and save pages to your SaaSFrame collections.

References are a starting point: rebuild with your own system, content and brand.
capabilities: Search real SaaS screens and flows
defaultPrompt: Show me pricing pages with a monthly and yearly toggle.
How do SaaS products onboard a new user?
I'm designing a settings page. What should I decide first?

positive.description: Find screens by what they say
positive.prompt: Use SaaSFrame: show me pricing pages with a monthly and yearly toggle.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a grid of real SaaS pricing pages, each with its SaaS name and a link to its SaaSFrame page.

positive.description: Open one reference with its measured styles
positive.prompt: Use SaaSFrame: open the Linear pricing page and tell me which fonts, sizes and colors it uses.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the screen, returns its screenshot and lists the typefaces, text sizes, colors and radii measured on the page.

positive.description: Study a user flow step by step
positive.prompt: Use SaaSFrame: how do SaaS products onboard a new user? Show me one flow step by step.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one or more onboarding flows as ordered screens, with a link for each step.

positive.description: Get the method for a screen type
positive.prompt: Use SaaSFrame: I'm designing a settings page. What should I decide first?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the guide for settings pages: what to decide first, what to do and avoid, benchmarks measured on real pages and searches to run next.

positive.description: Read a public website by section
positive.prompt: Use SaaSFrame: list the sections of https://linear.app and give me its hero as Tailwind code.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the page sections in order, then returns the hero section as Tailwind code written with the tokens measured on the page.

negative.description: Bulk extraction of the library is not supported: daily limits apply and the terms forbid building datasets. The assistant should explain this and offer to search for specific references instead.
negative.prompt: Download every screen in the SaaSFrame library as a dataset.

negative.description: No tool deletes data. The assistant should say it cannot delete a collection and point the user to their SaaSFrame account.
negative.prompt: Delete my Fintech collection on SaaSFrame.

negative.description: References are a starting point, not content to ship. The assistant should not reproduce another company's brand, logo and text for the user's site, and should offer a version with the user's own brand and content.
negative.prompt: Copy Stripe's homepage exactly, with its logo and text, for my own site.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. A SaaSFrame Pro or Team subscription, bought on saasframe.io, is required to use the tools.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search real SaaS screens, sections and flows, read measured styles, inspect and export public website sections, save pages to collections.
